name: cache-clock
description: A countdown above the prompt that shows when the chat's prompt cache goes cold, what that would cost, and an opt-in, capped Keep warm button. Offers a handoff to a fresh chat when a big chat goes cold.

cache_length.title: Cache length
cache_length.description: How long the chat's cache stays warm after a reply. auto reads it from the last reply; pick 5m or 1h to force it.

read_transcript.title: Read the chat log to find the cache length
read_transcript.description: On: the last few hundred KB of this chat's own log file are read, on your computer only, to see whether the last reply wrote a 5 min or a 1 hour cache. Off: the length is a guess unless you set Cache length.

show_cost.title: Show cost estimates
show_cost.description: Show what replying now and a cold restart cost, and what Keep warm has spent.

input_price_per_million.title: Input price per million tokens (USD)
input_price_per_million.description: Used for the cost estimates. 0 means use Claude Code's own figure when it gives one, else a list-price guess by model family.

big_chat_tokens.title: Big chat size (tokens)
big_chat_tokens.description: A cold chat at least this big gets the handoff offer. 0 turns the offer off.

handoff_command.title: Handoff command
handoff_command.description: The slash command (without the slash) that moves the chat to a fresh one. The button only shows when this command exists.

warm_max_pings.title: Keep warm: most pings
warm_max_pings.description: Keep warm stops by itself after this many pings. Each ping costs tokens.

warm_max_minutes.title: Keep warm: most minutes
warm_max_minutes.description: Keep warm stops by itself after this many minutes.

warm_lead_seconds.title: Keep warm: ping this many seconds before the cache goes cold
